answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 31827 Country: India Title: I saw a dream doing zina with my mother. im not married yet and have also been adopted by my parents. Question: I saw a dream doing zina with my mother. im not married yet and have also been adopted by my parents. Answer ID: 31827 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 727/602/B=1432) If the dreamer is a worldly man, he might be consuming unlawful and haram earning i.e. interest, so he should avoid it. But if he is a pious person, he shall achieve the status of abdiyat i.e. he shall have humility. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
